en.t_11vwukbd4wwg2: Listen. Diagnose. Care. Safe, evidence-based medicine with a patient-first, ethical approach — for lasting health.
en.t_05lyhiz2xezuy: Your care starts with a conversation. We take a full history, examine carefully, review your tests and then explain your options with a clear written plan — no rushing, no confusion.
en.t_1tlieo218ybt2j: An honest assessment, the right tests and a clear, personal care plan.
en.t_1xk0dm245kd3v: A thorough head-to-toe physical exam with a review of your medicines and family history is the foundation of good care — so problems are found early and treated before they grow.
en.t_1kh9pi417outha: Comprehensive physical exam to keep you healthy for life.
en.t_0habiiuv2mk8p: Secure video visits make it easy to review lab results, adjust medicines and ask questions without travelling — ideal for follow-ups and family members abroad.
en.t_0lpddlbjp9maz: Fever, infections, persistent cough or sudden illness are assessed promptly, with careful testing and safe, evidence-based treatment — and clear advice on when to seek urgent care.
en.t_0a4nect13blor: Acid reflux, stomach pain, bloating, fatty liver and abnormal liver tests are evaluated step by step, with diet guidance and targeted treatment to restore digestive comfort.
en.t_17mkyorpovj0j: Healthy weight is built on habits you can keep. Dr. Bilal combines nutrition advice, the right balance of cardio and strength exercise and, when needed, medical therapy for lasting results.
en.t_1ofbs491c37xao: Blood tests, ECGs and imaging results are reviewed in detail and explained in plain language, so you always understand what your numbers mean and what comes next.
en.t_1ju1hky1p6hxdx: Asthma, COPD, chronic cough and breathlessness are diagnosed carefully and managed with the right inhalers, lung-function follow-up and a plan to keep you active.
en.t_10fenmexemztt: Cholesterol testing and heart-risk assessment guide a personal plan of diet, activity and, when needed, medicines to lower LDL and protect your heart and arteries.
en.t_12eo9qr16076wc: Under-active or over-active thyroid and other hormone problems are diagnosed with the right blood tests and managed with careful medication adjustments and follow-up.
en.t_07uz8nilnnak8: Annual physicals, cancer and heart screenings, vaccinations and lab panels help catch silent problems early — the simplest way to stay healthy for years.
en.t_6r2h881xrbhw2: Drawing on nephrology research experience at Mayo Clinic, Dr. Bilal focuses on early detection of kidney disease, protecting kidney function and managing blood pressure, sugar, minerals and stones.
en.t_1ls8hh8asxy3a: High blood pressure rarely causes symptoms but quietly harms the heart, brain and kidneys. Careful diagnosis, home-monitoring guidance and the right medicines keep it under control.
en.t_1wcsfg67hrrmn: Diabetes affects far more than blood sugar — it impacts the heart, kidneys, eyes and nerves. Dr. Bilal provides complete diabetes care: the right tests and timing for checking sugar, HbA1c tracking, modern medicines and a realistic food and exercise plan.
en.t_1w0dd5cnip56l: Every visit begins with listening. A careful diagnosis, a plan designed around your life and goals, and evidence-based treatment for results that last.
